title: Switchyard Chapel - low-CPU six-lane patch plan
status: plan only: no Rack patch was built, loaded, auditioned or rendered
owner: Codex integrates and may revoice; parameter ranges below are suggestions, not loaded values
principles: One poly PVX carries lead and counterline; one mono PVX carries the strong bass.
Percussion is a compact set of oscillator/noise/envelope/VCA supports.
One restrained clean Spoon Bender may provide a short industrial space.
No firmware emulation, no large voice bank, no GPU/audio/image sampling prerequisite and no DC pulses.

lanes.name: kick
lanes.plan: Tight syncopated kick from a short oscillator/click envelope.

lanes.name: snare
lanes.plan: Noise snare/clap with a short decay; ghost hits stay quiet.

lanes.name: hat/texture
lanes.plan: Short filtered noise ticks; 8th or 16th according to the pattern.

lanes.name: lead
lanes.plan: Bright FM/electro PVX call and response, short envelopes.

lanes.name: bass
lanes.plan: One mono PVX bass, syncopated and forward but not layered.

lanes.name: counterline/atmosphere
lanes.plan: Sparse high counterline through the same PVX or a small Spoon Bender return.

percussion.cpu_note: Small and algorithmic; no sampled kit.

routing_intent: Lanes 4 and 6 to one poly PVX; lane 5 to one mono PVX.
Lanes 1-3 to the compact percussion supports.
Lane 6 may take a short Spoon Bender send; keep the dry bass forward.
No sidechain network, no multi-tap delay and no external sequencer.

PVX_lead.note: Bright but not harsh; leave the breakdown exposed.

PVX_bass.note: Strong mono figure; avoid a layered sub or distortion stack.

percussion.note: Tight kick, dry snare and short hats; ghost velocities stay low.

space.note: Short slap/room only if it helps the call/response.

gorgon_bridge: Gorgon poly pitch12/gates11/velocity3 are the real bridge outputs from the score. Suggested velocity goes to a VCA, not to PVX input2.
pvx_input2: PVX input2 is external AUDIO, not velocity. Any velocity suggestion in this plan belongs on a VCA.
limits: No patch was loaded or auditioned here.
codex_discretion: All machine numbers are neutral score slots and may be replaced.
Parameter ranges are starting suggestions only; Codex owns the real patch and audio review.
The breakdown may use fewer percussion sources without changing the note data.
